semiconductor_relevance: High — DISCO HI-TEC EUROPE GmbH provides advanced equipment and solutions specifically for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: DISCO HI-TEC EUROPE GmbH is a total solution provider specializing in advanced dicing, wafer thinning, and various laser processes for the semiconductor industry. They offer a range of equipment and services including dicing and grinding services, as well as automatic optical inspection solutions.
capabilities: Wafer dicing by blade and laser methods
Wafer thinning through grinding and polishing techniques
Dicing tape and grinding tape production

regional_presence.Europe: The company has a cleanroom facility in Munich, Germany, for dicing and grinding services.
